description: Fingerprints the packaged Development Linux binary and content archive (pak) actually produced by scripts/package_sim.sh, plus the git tree that produced them. built_from_git_head is the repo's HEAD at package time, which routinely precedes the commit that later records this file -- packaging happens before committing, not after. working_tree_dirty says whether uncommitted changes were present in that tree (e.g. an in-progress fix not yet committed). Do not compare built_from_git_head to the current HEAD to judge freshness; that comparison is circular. Gate on binary.sha256 instead.
